WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1793221571845
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793826371845
    AND e.event IN ('$pageview', 'signup_completed', 'subscription_started')
),
firsts AS (SELECT distinct_id, MIN(ts_ms) AS t FROM ev WHERE event = '$pageview' GROUP BY distinct_id),
touch AS (
  SELECT ev.distinct_id, MIN(CASE
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ev.utm_medium, '')) IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid', 'paidsearch', 'paid_search', 'paid-search', 'paidsocial', 'paid_social', 'paid-social', 'display', 'cpm', 'banner', 'ads') THEN 'Paid'
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ev.utm_medium, '')) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'newsletter') OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.utm_source, '')) IN ('email', 'newsletter') THEN 'Email'
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ev.utm_medium, '')) IN ('social', 'social-media', 'social_media', 'sm', 'organic_social') THEN 'Social'
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%chatgpt.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%openai.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%perplexity.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%claude.ai' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%gemini.google.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%copilot.microsoft.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%you.com' THEN 'AI assistants'
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%google.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%bing.com%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%duckduckgo.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%yahoo.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%ecosia.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%baidu.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%yandex.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%search.brave.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%startpage.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%qwant.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%kagi.%' THEN 'Organic search'
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%facebook.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE 'fb.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%instagram.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE 't.co' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%twitter.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE 'x.com' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%linkedin.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE 'lnkd.in' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%reddit.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%youtube.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE 'youtu.be' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%tiktok.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%pinterest.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%threads.net' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%bsky.app' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%mastodon%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%whatsapp.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%telegram.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%news.ycombinator.%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) LIKE '%substack.%' THEN 'Social'
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ev.utm_source, '')) <> '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(ev.utm_campaign, '')) <> '' THEN 'Other campaigns'
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ev.referrer_host, '')) <> '' THEN 'Referral'
    ELSE 'Direct'
  END) AS val
  FROM ev JOIN firsts ON firsts.distinct_id = ev.distinct_id AND ev.ts_ms = firsts.t AND ev.event = '$pageview'
  GROUP BY ev.distinct_id
),
visits AS (SELECT distinct_id, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, COUNT(*) AS views FROM ev WHERE event = '$pageview' GROUP BY distinct_id),
conv AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id FROM ev WHERE event IN ('signup_completed', 'subscription_started'))
SELECT touch.val AS val, COUNT(*) AS visitors, SUM(visits.sessions) AS sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN conv.distinct_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS converted,
  SUM(CASE WHEN visits.views = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounced
FROM touch
JOIN visits ON visits.distinct_id = touch.distinct_id
LEFT JOIN conv ON conv.distinct_id = touch.distinct_id
GROUP BY touch.val ORDER BY visitors DESC LIMIT 20
summary: Top channels by visitors: Direct 328 (6.4% converted), Organic search 227 (13.7% converted), Social 136 (11.0% converted), Paid 38 (13.2% converted), Email 35 (17.1% converted).
